opener_concept: Density as mass shared out per unit volume: a 4 cm3 lump of metal weighs 12 g, so 1 cm3 weighs 3 g (a quarter of the size, a quarter of the mass) and 10 cm3 weighs 30 g. Pure common-sense sharing/scaling, then the reveal names it as rho = m/V.
